furtherCandidatesOnlyIfConcreteResidual.proposal: For hydration only, validate the complete bounded batch first into byte-offset descriptors, then consume Buffer subarrays without the intermediate Buffer.from copy per object. Keep the existing allocating readImmutableGitFiles API.
furtherCandidatesOnlyIfConcreteResidual.observedReason: Current hydration receives the whole cat-file output plus a second full copy of every decoded blob. The 297s profile reached 2.42GB RSS; avoiding that simultaneous extra copy can reduce memory pressure without skipping a raw read.
requiredBoundaries: All header/order/type/size/object-SHA/trailing-byte checks finish before the first consumer callback.
No retained byte cache or approval result cache. Fresh cat-file invocation and original whole-cohort replays remain.
A corrupted final object must cause zero callbacks, preserving existing all-batch validation behavior.
furtherCandidatesOnlyIfConcreteResidual.expectedGain: Unmeasured; do not claim a time saving before the official rerun.

furtherCandidatesOnlyIfConcreteResidual.observedReason: Audit append asks for identical unchanged assets at multiple source snapshots. Each current call repeats fresh bytes for the same immutable object.

Do not apply the count-bounded exact-JSON parser cache to all large metadata/identity/runtime documents; 128 large entries can worsen RSS.
